mechanism: Indomethacin inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, potentially increasing modafinil plasma concentrations; modafinil may increase indomethacin levels via CYP2C9 inhibition, elevating NSAID-related adverse effects.
action: Monitor for modafinil toxicity (headache, insomnia, tachycardia) and NSAID-related GI/renal effects; consider dose adjustment or alternative NSAID if excessive modafinil effects occur.
